historical_record.description: The Recreation Commission awarded one $842,000 contract to Carrico & Gautier to build four recreation centers: Potrero Hill, Ocean View, St. Mary's and Sunset.
St. Mary's Playground, Crescent and Agnon Avenues, was dedicated, according to the official list of 1947 recreation bond playgrounds the Recreation and Park Commission entered in its minutes.
The Recreation Commission contracted with architect William G. Merchant, for $7,680, to furnish plans for a field house at St. Mary's Playground.
